steps.name: 시험 시트 zstui1~4 만들기(A1:A7 = r1~r7 · B2·B5)
steps.js: const st=[];for(const d of [{"id": "zstui1", "title": "구조 뒤 옛 판", "kind": "sheet", "slides": [], "sheets": [{"id": "t01", "name": "S", "cells": {"A1": "r1", "A2": "r2", "A3": "r3", "A4": "r4", "A5": "r5", "A6": "r6", "A7": "r7", "B2": "옛B2", "B5": "옛B5"}}]}, {"id": "zstui2", "title": "구조 뒤 옛 판", "kind": "sheet", "slides": [], "sheets": [{"id": "t01", "name": "S", "cells": {"A1": "r1", "A2": "r2", "A3": "r3", "A4": "r4", "A5": "r5", "A6": "r6", "A7": "r7", "B2": "옛B2", "B5": "옛B5"}}]}, {"id": "zstui3", "title": "구조 뒤 옛 판", "kind": "sheet", "slides": [], "sheets": [{"id": "t01", "name": "S", "cells": {"A1": "r1", "A2": "r2", "A3": "r3", "A4": "r4", "A5": "r5", "A6": "r6", "A7": "r7", "B2": "옛B2", "B5": "옛B5"}}]}, {"id": "zstui4", "title": "구조 뒤 옛 판", "kind": "sheet", "slides": [], "sheets": [{"id": "t01", "name": "S", "cells": {"A1": "r1", "A2": "r2", "A3": "r3", "A4": "r4", "A5": "r5", "A6": "r6", "A7": "r7", "B2": "옛B2", "B5": "옛B5"}}]}]){const p=await fetch('/api/deck/'+d.id,{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(d)});st.push(p.status);}return st.every(x=>x===200)||JSON.stringify(st);

steps.name: (ii-1) 다른 창 행 삽입 직후(실시간 갱신 전) 화면이 B5 를 고침 → 화면·서버 모두 B6 = 화면 값(옛B5 를 바꿈) · B5 빈 칸
steps.js: const N=window.NexaSheet,S=N.S,X=N.x;const idle=()=>until(async()=>(!S.dirty&&!S.saving&&document.querySelector('#status').textContent==='저장됨'),10000);const srv=async()=>{const r=await fetch('/api/deck/zstui1',{cache:'no-store'});return {v:r.headers.get('X-Deck-Version'),d:await r.json()};};const show=c=>Object.keys(c).filter(k=>/^[AB]/.test(k)).sort((a,b)=>a[0]===b[0]?(+a.slice(1))-(+b.slice(1)):a<b?-1:1).map(k=>k+'='+c[k]).join(' ');const extIns=async()=>{const {v,d}=await srv();const so=[{op:'insertRows',tab:'t01',at:1,n:1}];const c=d.sheets[0].cells,nc={};for(const [k,val] of Object.entries(c)){const r=+k.slice(1);nc[k[0]+(r>=2?r+1:r)]=val;}d.sheets[0].cells=nc;d.__struct=so;const p=await fetch('/api/deck/zstui1?merge=1&base='+encodeURIComponent(v),{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Nexa-Tab':'other'},body:JSON.stringify(d)});return p.status;};await idle();const st=await extIns();X.mutate(()=>{X.sheet().cells.B5='화면이 고침';});await idle();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000));await idle();const fin=(await srv()).d,c=fin.sheets[0].cells,s=X.sheet().cells;return st===200&&c.B6==='화면이 고침'&&!c.B5&&s.B6==='화면이 고침'&&!s.B5&&c.A3==='r2'?true:JSON.stringify({st,server:show(c),screen:show(s)});

steps.name: (ii-2) 다른 창 행 삽입 → 실시간 갱신을 받은 뒤 옮겨진 자리(B6)를 고침 → 그 자리
steps.js: const N=window.NexaSheet,S=N.S,X=N.x;const idle=()=>until(async()=>(!S.dirty&&!S.saving&&document.querySelector('#status').textContent==='저장됨'),10000);const srv=async()=>{const r=await fetch('/api/deck/zstui2',{cache:'no-store'});return {v:r.headers.get('X-Deck-Version'),d:await r.json()};};const show=c=>Object.keys(c).filter(k=>/^[AB]/.test(k)).sort((a,b)=>a[0]===b[0]?(+a.slice(1))-(+b.slice(1)):a<b?-1:1).map(k=>k+'='+c[k]).join(' ');const extIns=async()=>{const {v,d}=await srv();const so=[{op:'insertRows',tab:'t01',at:1,n:1}];const c=d.sheets[0].cells,nc={};for(const [k,val] of Object.entries(c)){const r=+k.slice(1);nc[k[0]+(r>=2?r+1:r)]=val;}d.sheets[0].cells=nc;d.__struct=so;const p=await fetch('/api/deck/zstui2?merge=1&base='+encodeURIComponent(v),{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Nexa-Tab':'other'},body:JSON.stringify(d)});return p.status;};await idle();await extIns();await until(async()=>(X.sheet().cells.A8==='r7'),8000);X.mutate(()=>{X.sheet().cells.B6='화면이 고침2';});await idle();const c=(await srv()).d.sheets[0].cells;return c.B6==='화면이 고침2'&&c.B3==='옛B2'?true:JSON.stringify(show(c));

steps.name: (iii) 양쪽 다 행 삽입 → 409 struct-both 안내 '다른 창도 행·열을' · [내 것으로 덮어쓰기] → 내 문서(내 행 삽입·편집)가 남고 다른 창 행 삽입은 사라짐
steps.js: const N=window.NexaSheet,S=N.S,X=N.x;const idle=()=>until(async()=>(!S.dirty&&!S.saving&&document.querySelector('#status').textContent==='저장됨'),10000);const srv=async()=>{const r=await fetch('/api/deck/zstui3',{cache:'no-store'});return {v:r.headers.get('X-Deck-Version'),d:await r.json()};};const show=c=>Object.keys(c).filter(k=>/^[AB]/.test(k)).sort((a,b)=>a[0]===b[0]?(+a.slice(1))-(+b.slice(1)):a<b?-1:1).map(k=>k+'='+c[k]).join(' ');const extIns=async()=>{const {v,d}=await srv();const so=[{op:'insertRows',tab:'t01',at:1,n:1}];const c=d.sheets[0].cells,nc={};for(const [k,val] of Object.entries(c)){const r=+k.slice(1);nc[k[0]+(r>=2?r+1:r)]=val;}d.sheets[0].cells=nc;d.__struct=so;const p=await fetch('/api/deck/zstui3?merge=1&base='+encodeURIComponent(v),{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Nexa-Tab':'other'},body:JSON.stringify(d)});return p.status;};await idle();const st=await extIns();X.shiftAxis('r',4,1);X.mutate(()=>{X.sheet().cells.B6='화면이 고침';});await until(async()=>(document.querySelector('#banner').classList.contains('show')),10000);const msg=document.querySelector('#bannerMsg').textContent;document.querySelector('#bnMine').click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));await until(async()=>(!S.saving&&!document.querySelector('#banner').classList.contains('show')),10000);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800));const c=(await srv()).d.sheets[0].cells,s=X.sheet().cells;return st===200&&/다른 창도 행·열을/.test(msg)&&c.A4==='r4'&&c.A5===undefined&&c.A6==='r5'&&c.B6==='화면이 고침'&&c.A3==='r3'&&s.A6==='r5'?true:JSON.stringify({st,msg,server:show(c),screen:show(s)});

steps.name: (iii) 양쪽 다 행 삽입 → 409 struct-both 안내 '다른 창도 행·열을' · [밖의 것 다시 읽기] → 다른 창 문서(그쪽 행 삽입)로 · 내 편집은 사라짐(Ctrl+Z 로 복구 안내)
steps.js: const N=window.NexaSheet,S=N.S,X=N.x;const idle=()=>until(async()=>(!S.dirty&&!S.saving&&document.querySelector('#status').textContent==='저장됨'),10000);const srv=async()=>{const r=await fetch('/api/deck/zstui4',{cache:'no-store'});return {v:r.headers.get('X-Deck-Version'),d:await r.json()};};const show=c=>Object.keys(c).filter(k=>/^[AB]/.test(k)).sort((a,b)=>a[0]===b[0]?(+a.slice(1))-(+b.slice(1)):a<b?-1:1).map(k=>k+'='+c[k]).join(' ');const extIns=async()=>{const {v,d}=await srv();const so=[{op:'insertRows',tab:'t01',at:1,n:1}];const c=d.sheets[0].cells,nc={};for(const [k,val] of Object.entries(c)){const r=+k.slice(1);nc[k[0]+(r>=2?r+1:r)]=val;}d.sheets[0].cells=nc;d.__struct=so;const p=await fetch('/api/deck/zstui4?merge=1&base='+encodeURIComponent(v),{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Nexa-Tab':'other'},body:JSON.stringify(d)});return p.status;};await idle();const st=await extIns();X.shiftAxis('r',4,1);X.mutate(()=>{X.sheet().cells.B6='화면이 고침';});await until(async()=>(document.querySelector('#banner').classList.contains('show')),10000);const msg=document.querySelector('#bannerMsg').textContent;document.querySelector('#bnTheirs').click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));await until(async()=>(!S.saving&&!document.querySelector('#banner').classList.contains('show')),10000);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800));const c=(await srv()).d.sheets[0].cells,s=X.sheet().cells;return st===200&&/다른 창도 행·열을/.test(msg)&&c.A3==='r2'&&c.A8==='r7'&&!JSON.stringify(c).includes('화면이 고침')&&s.A3==='r2'&&!JSON.stringify(s).includes('화면이 고침')?true:JSON.stringify({st,msg,server:show(c),screen:show(s)});
